meaning: The Quranic form تَرَاقِي in 75:26 is the plural of تَرْقُوَة, the collarbone/clavicle. The unrelated loanword تِرْيَاق, 'antidote,' should not define this Quranic page.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
meaning_source_d2: The word "ترياق" (tiryāq) is an arabicized term, possibly from Greek or Persian, referring to an antidote for poisons.
